title.value: Refounding the Hearths: Mobile Settlement, Glass Supply and the Nightward Margin Exchange on the Terminator Band of Fetch

abstract.value: The Dusk March circuit refounds its hearths at each stop by carrying coals from the last, a procedure that takes precedence over shelter, water and food, and which fails perhaps once a decade. We follow four circuits and relate refounding intervals to glass quarry access and to the volume of the nightward exchange with the cold-locker trap keepers. Where the exchange is heavy the circuit slows and the hearth spacing tightens, which the walkers describe as the fire getting expensive. A failed refounding is not treated as a disaster but as a debt, owed to whichever hearth supplies the replacement coals.
